sample.rule: original-vector cells published at 2x or more, shorter side >= 8 px, longer side <= 1024 px, native raster of class flat or shaded whose line-like thin parts (skeleton >= 4 px) hold >= 0.5 of the coverage

method: Equal tails: IoU minimum at the q-th percentile, both error maxima at the (100-q)-th, of the calibration half; the largest q in steps of 0.05 whose gate passes at least 95% of the calibration renders on every check at once (stable-interior colour check included).
